map.HMAC 是带密钥的哈希消息认证码，服务端用同一密钥验证请求未被篡改。本工具选算: HMAC is a keyed hash-based message authentication code; the server verifies with the same key that the request has not been tampered with. In this tool you select the algorithm, enter the message and the key, and get the signature. Computation runs locally and the key is never uploaded.
map.密钥与消息分离: Keep the key separate from the message
map.选哈希算法(常用 SHA256): Select a hash algorithm (SHA256 is common)
map.点生成得签名: Click generate to get the signature
map.复制给对方校验: Copy it for the other party to verify
map.密钥务必保密、两端一致: Keep the key secret and identical on both ends
map.签名用于防篡改非加密: The signature prevents tampering, it does not encrypt
map.十六进制与 Base64 需约定一致: Hexadecimal and Base64 must follow the same convention
map.HMAC 和哈希区别？: What is the difference between HMAC and a hash?
map.HMAC 多了密钥，单方无法伪造。: HMAC adds a key, so one party alone cannot forge it.
map.消息\"hello\"、密钥\"key\"、HMAC-SHA256 得一段 64: Message 'hello', key 'key', HMAC-SHA256 gives a 64-character hexadecimal string.
